record_title: Beta-random graphon limits and two-scale edge fluctuations for Polya threshold graphs
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Restricted to the classical constant-reinforcement two-color Polya model and to the simple graph after self-loop deletion. No cut-distance rate or full motif-vector fluctuation theorem is claimed. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from older exchangeable-graph, urn, and threshold-graph literature under different terminology.
